values.note: Free campground with no reservation system: the Forest Service page lists no fee and no booking link, and recreation.gov has no listing for it (the only 'Pines Campground' there is in New Mexico).

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/pines-campground ('No fees are required for this site'; no reservation information) + recreation.gov search near 37.605,-80.076 (no matching facility), read 2026-10-21

values.note: The Forest Service page gives two closing dates: 'Seasons of Use: April 1 - December 7' and 'Open April 1 - November 1'.

season.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/pines-campground ('Seasons of Use April 1 - December 7'; 'Operational Hours Open April 1 - November 1'), read 2026-10-21

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/pines-campground ('Restrooms Vault toilet(s)'; 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-21

summary: Forest Service page: confirmed free; added first-come/not reservable (the inherited recreation.gov booking row is wrong: no rec.gov listing), season opening April 1 with two published closing dates (Dec 7 / Nov 1) in season.note, vault toilets, no drinking water. Not stated: site count, RV lengths. AWH note left as is.
flags: RV fit unconfirmed: the Forest Service says 'Most of the campsites are designed for tents, but small recreation vehicles can be accommodated' (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/pines-campground), with no site length; whether any site takes a 23-ft rig is not stated.
Inherited federal booking row (reservable via recreation.gov, 180-day window) is wrong for this free first-come site; this result overrides it.
Phone missing: the managing Eastern Divide Ranger District office is 540-552-4641 (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r08/gwj/recreation/pines-campground).
